source: reconstruction of a GitLab project accepting fork merge requests with every variable protected
note: Settings variables of a third-party project cannot be read, so this reproduces the shape: fork merge requests run the tests on python:3.12-slim (a tag, no digest), every variable is protected, and the release runs on tags with a digest-pinned image. GitLab exports protected variables only to protected branches and tags, so the merge-request-only test job holds nothing and its mutable image is runner abuse at worst: Medium. The release holds PYPI_TOKEN and publishes, but nothing mutable enters it.
